answer: A workable design: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The sparrow of work and the basalt of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a tundra to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
